purpose: Select four boundary states before testing the descriptive key families.
question: To what extent can the person currently perform their essential work?

descriptions.full: The person can complete every essential job duty at normal quality and pace without assistance.
descriptions.partial: The person can complete some essential job duties, but at least one essential duty cannot be completed at normal quality or pace.
descriptions.none: The person cannot complete any essential job duty.

randomization.unit: complete balanced block containing every calibration state once

states.r00_explicit_normal: My computer is broken, but from my phone I can complete every essential job duty at normal quality and pace without assistance.
states.r01_normal_pace_less_convenient: My computer is broken, but from my phone I can complete every essential job duty at normal quality and pace without assistance. The phone is less convenient.
states.r02_normal_pace_not_full_day: My computer is broken, but from my phone I can complete every essential job duty at normal quality and pace without assistance. I have not yet used the phone workflow for a full day.
states.r03_roughly_normal_pace: My computer is broken, but from my phone I can complete every essential job duty at normal quality and roughly normal pace without assistance.
states.r04_close_to_normal_pace: My computer is broken, but from my phone I can complete every essential job duty at normal quality. My pace is close to normal, although the phone is less convenient.
states.r05_maybe_one_slight_delay: My computer is broken, but from my phone I can complete every essential job duty at normal quality and pace without assistance. One duty might occasionally take slightly longer.
states.r06_unsure_one_slight_delay: My computer is broken, but from my phone I can complete every essential job duty at normal quality. Most duties are at normal pace; I am unsure whether one duty may take slightly longer.
states.r07_one_duty_sometimes_slower: My computer is broken, but from my phone I can complete every essential job duty at normal quality. One duty is sometimes slightly slower than normal.
states.r08_one_duty_slightly_slower: My computer is broken, but from my phone I can complete every essential job duty at normal quality. One duty takes slightly longer than normal.
states.r09_one_duty_noticeably_slower: My computer is broken, but from my phone I can complete every essential job duty at normal quality. One duty takes noticeably longer than normal.
states.r10_one_duty_not_normal_pace: My computer is broken, but from my phone I can complete every essential job duty at normal quality. One essential duty cannot be completed at normal pace.
states.r11_explicit_partial: My computer is broken. From my phone I can complete some essential job duties, but at least one essential duty cannot be completed at normal quality or pace.
